description.en: Plugins maintained by run-dream for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: run-dream 维护的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Migrate a whole DeepSeek account (every conversation, with thinking, web-search evidence, images and attachments) into DeepSeek Harness sessions. Say one sentence; it auto-detects your browser, logs you in once, and imports everything.
description.zh: 把一个 DeepSeek 账号的对话整体迁到 dsh：思维链、联网搜索证据、图片原图、附件一起搬。装好后说一句话即可，自动检测浏览器、只需登录一次。
